Hi Jordan,

Apologies for the short notice — our procurement team needs Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation of the audit period to complete legal review for SummitHealth's pilot contract. The compliance checklist in the attached RFP calls for a Type II report covering at least the last 12 months; our audit window closes on 2027-11-12.

Jordan — thanks for flagging. Quick status and recommended path:

- Current: Our latest finalized SOC 2 Type II report covers audit period 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31 (Type II issued 2027-05-12). We do not yet have a published Type II that extends through the requested 12-month window.

- Fast path (recommended): Provide an interim attestation signed by our Head of Security and CFO that asserts our controls are in place for the requested period, accompanied by a scoped evidence bundle (control mappings, policy snapshots, sample log extracts). We can assemble the attestation + evidence in ~48 hours if we prioritize (we will need an exec sig off).

- Alternative: Request a bridge letter from our auditor confirming control coverage. That typically requires coordination with the auditor and may take 5–10 business days; not safe for their 11/12 window.

Operational asks:
1) Priyom/Evelyn — can you confirm availability to deliver the evidence bundle checklist (see e-bundle template) by EOD tomorrow? Specific items: access control evidence (IAM config + user access logs), change management tickets for the last 6 months, monitoring/alerting runbook excerpts, and a snapshot of our incident response table.
2) Neha — please review the interim attestation draft below. We will need Legal sign-off and Exec sign-off (CISO/CFO).
3) Jordan — if Sales can escalate for a short paid premium support or request an SLA exception, we can prioritize and commit resources now. Otherwise this goes into normal queue and timeline expands.

Draft interim attestation (short):
"Redwood Inference hereby attests that between [2026-11-01] and [2027-11-01], Redwood has maintained, to the best of its knowledge, the controls described in our SOC 2 control mapping in effect and operational. This attestation is provided as an interim measure pending completion of our next SOC 2 Type II engagement and does not replace a formal auditor-issued report"

I can take point on assembling the internal attestation package. Priyom/Evelyn — can you confirm the checklist ETA? Neha, I'll queue a Legal review in parallel.
